summary: Implemented KAFKA-20282: Added a log recommendation for users of the Classic rebalance protocol to consider switching to the new consumer rebalance protocol (KIP-848). The implementation logs "The consumer rebalance protocol (KIP-848) is production ready! Please consider switching to the new consumer protocol." at INFO level in ClassicKafkaConsumer when a GROUP_ID is configured. All four required test cases pass successfully: testClassicProtocolLogsRecommendationToTryConsumerProtocol, testConsumerProtocolDoesNotLogRecommendation, testDefaultProtocolLogsRecommendationToTryConsumerProtocol, and testNoGroupIdDoesNotLogGroupProtocolMessage. The entire KafkaConsumerTest suite passes with no regressions.
